hits.title: Show HN: Real-time inventory of natural stone slabs in US
hits.story_text:
We're building a real-time inventory of natural stone, quartz, and porcelain slabs in the US.

This is for countertop fabricators, who need to know slabs, pricing, sizing etc. and expose this inventory to their customers.

We are building this for fabricators, homeowners, suppliers - up and down the supply chain.

The idea is to build it into existing agent directories, so fabricators can ask Muse/Claude/Chat and possibly transact (as pictures of slabs keep getting better) directly as well.

If anyone from the industry is interested in chatting (about this or anything related), let me know below!
